name: tags_create
description: Create a custom project tag (not a review status). Same as the feed footer: owner/admin/editor (`canCreate`). Pass projectReference from folders_list (project or folder ref by name — folder refs resolve to root project; UI folder irrelevant). Statuses already exist — never create those. On general feeds without a named project, ask which project unless onlyProjects shows a single project or only project_default. On duplicate/limit errors reuse existing — do not retry.
